name: Johannesburg
routeRole: Interchange city and starting point of the simulated long-distance leg
story: Johannesburg is where Lerato's journey changes character. She finishes an operating Gautrain ride, then follows a simulated historical route from the separate Johannesburg Park Station. Rails & Roots uses the change to help her understand both the transport connection and the city around it.
visitorNote: Constitution Hill is a separate heritage attraction, not part of the station interchange. Its walking or transport connection has not been verified here.
